title: Internet Speed Test
aboutText: This tool measures your real-time download bandwidth by fetching a sample data file from a fast content delivery network. Checking your internet speed helps you confirm if you are getting the bandwidth promised by your internet service provider.
tip1: Close active downloads, streaming apps, or online video calls before starting.
tip2: Connect directly using a LAN cable or sit closer to your Wi-Fi router.
tip3: Run the test a few times to get an accurate average connection speed.
faq1A: Mbps stands for Megabits per second, which is the standard unit used to measure network download speed.
faq2Q: Is this test completely free to use?
faq2A: Yes, this online speed test runs entirely inside your web browser without requiring any software installation.
